name: ssh-core-ssh-daemon
title: ship ssh-core ssh_daemon v1.0
description: Long-lived connection pool per alias: 127.0.0.1:<random> daemon, 4-byte big-endian length + UTF-8 JSON wire, paramiko send_ignore() heartbeat every 60s, idle 30min default, state at $TMPDIR/ssh_daemon/<md5(alias)>.json (mode 0600). Subcommands: start/status/stop/list.
creator: jason
